build_dataset_xtreme_s: build a tfds dataset for the XTREME-S benchmark with FLEURS speech recognition data across 102 languages
create_config_xtreme_s: create an XtremeSConfig builder config for a specific FLEURS language dataset variant
build_config_name: build an XtremeSConfig from a dataset name string like fleurs.en or fleurs.all
generate_examples_fleurs: generate examples from FLEURS audio and text paths yielding speech transcription records
split_generators_fleurs: split FLEURS data into train, validation, and test splits from downloaded archives
